entries.title: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
entries.summary: Modular harness variants are recombined by a bandit-guided search, with validation-driven edits feeding reusable module pools for later improvement.

entries.title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
entries.summary: VERSE uses execution verification to evolve both an executor harness and the optimizer's own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes.

entries.title: SEIS: Self-Evolving Inference Systems
entries.summary: Successive agent sessions inherit experience and code changes to optimize an LLM inference engine end to end, producing cumulative system improvement.

entries.title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts
entries.summary: LOOM stabilizes deep recurrent MoE computation and diversifies expert routing, enabling useful scaling to substantially more than two loops.

entries.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
entries.summary: LoopCD contrasts early and final recurrent predictions, turning otherwise discarded loop states into training-free decoding guidance that can reduce required depth.

entries.title: LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers
entries.summary: LiFT gives recurrent Diffusion Transformer steps continuous correction targets, allowing inference to extrapolate beyond training depth and improve with extra loops.

entries.title: Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning
entries.summary: Grafting learns updates on earlier checkpoints and merges scaled updates into post-trained LMs, reducing interference between new and retained capabilities.

entries.title: Task Vector Descent: Learning from Non-IID Batches
entries.summary: Partial integration of task vectors and optimizer state improves stability-plasticity when language-model training data arrives in temporally clustered distributions.

entries.title: The Optimization Landscape of Learning Compacted Context Models
entries.summary: A simplified Perceiver-style compactor improves continuous KV-memory compression for frozen language models, supporting bounded external state as experience accumulates.

entries.title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
entries.summary: ASCENT distills an LLM's verified deployment trajectories into persistent LoRA fast weights, letting performance improve as cross-task experience accumulates.

entries.title: Dynamic Routing as a New Dimension for Test-time Versatility of LLMs
entries.summary: Few demonstrations select layer-skipping or layer-iteration programs, adapting a frozen Transformer's computation to new tasks without gradient updates.

entries.title: Efficient Test-time Adaptation through Candidate Verification and Divergence Shifts
entries.summary: Test-Time Correction adapts VLM predictions by verifying candidate labels against latent memory-bank geometry, avoiding iterative optimization at inference.
